Annex A category 12 covers vegetable oils and fats generally, which includes canola, sunflower, coconut, avocado and sesame cooking oils. The only other in-force fats-and-oils lead rows are equal (HK Cap 132V, Thailand MoPH 414/2020 and GSO 193:2021 'edible fats and oils' at 80) or looser (EU 2023/915 'fats and oils, including milk fat' 100; SG, IN, VN, PY, MERCOSUR, UY, PA and FJ at 100 to 200); the 40 ug/kg rows are 'fat spreads and blended spreads' and the 20 ug/kg Vietnamese row is 'dairy fat products', both different products, so no stricter same-basis row is missing.
